answer: Slash lockstep, not keys: require each identity to post a bond, and when many identities vote, fail, and spend in statistical unison, treat them as one entity and slash their bonds together. An attacker can mint a thousand wallets but cannot make them behave independently. One beacon synced from a single source lights a whole karst plateau at once, while honest actors answer at their own pace, and identical deposits into one vault betray a single hand. Correlation is the confession.
